[SWS_DM_01373] Representation of Diagnostic Server instance by SOVD subcomponents
⌈
Each Diagnostic Server instance shall be repre-
sented by one corresponding SOVD component that shall be a child of the SOVD com-
ponent representing the DM in the role subcomponent. The corresponding component-
identifier shall be derived from the SoftwareClusterSovdAddress.
